name: Logo sting
description: A 3 to 8 second animated logo for the start or end of your videos. Three directions as stills, then the final. The quickest way to try Mortiflix.

intake.label: Your logo (SVG or a large PNG)
How should it feel?
intake.help: e.g. calm and premium, playful, technical, bold

steps.name: Directions
steps.describe: Three different motion ideas, each shown as a strip of 3 key moments (start, middle, settled logo), plus a one-line description. Ask which one.

checks.title: The logo is never distorted
checks.how: The settled logo matches the file exactly: proportions, colours, spacing. It's never stretched, recoloured or redrawn (animate its parts, don't change them).

checks.title: The logo holds at the end
checks.how: The final logo sits still for at least the last 1.5 seconds (or 1 second on a 3 s sting) so it can be read and cut from.

checks.title: Inside the safe area
checks.how: The settled logo sits at least 10% inside each frame edge; nothing clips during the motion.

checks.title: Every frame makes sense
checks.how: qc.mjs passes (frozen = the designed end hold is fine: say so) and you looked at its sheet.

checks.title: The right size, rate and length
checks.how: qc.mjs: 1920x1080 (or the brief's), constant 30 fps (or 60 if asked), H.264 + AAC (ProRes 4444 for transparent), duration within 5%.

checks.title: The sound sits right
checks.how: If it has sound: true peak ≤ -1 dBTP and loud enough to hear over nothing (-16 to -12 LUFS); no click at the start or end.
